summary_en: Company reviewed FY3/26 progress on capital-cost and share-price-conscious management; board assessed current state and updated capital allocation approach on 26 June 2026. Specific metrics and targets not disclosed in headline.
title_en: Response to Realizing Capital-Cost and Share-Price-Conscious Management – Update
translation_en_brief: On 26 June 2026, DENSAN CO., LTD.'s board of directors reviewed the company's FY3/26 progress on capital-cost and share-price-conscious management. The company assessed its current state and updated its response accordingly. The headline release does not disclose specific metrics, targets, or new initiatives; detailed information is contained in the attached materials, which are not reproduced in the extract provided.
